entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Calling upon the winds and the waves, you prepare your allies for the dangers of the natural world.

Prerequisite(s): Channel positive energy 3d6, worshiper of a god of nature.

Benefit(s): Once per day when you channel positive energy to heal living creatures, you can choose to grant each healed creature the benefit of endure elements (caster level equal to your effective cleric level). This effect lasts 24 hours.
